description: Loads the URL in Chrome and compares what a crawler that does not run JavaScript receives (the raw HTML) with the rendered page, using the Unrendered extension's analysis. Returns the share of the main content present in the raw HTML, words only added by JavaScript, the text blocks missing from the raw HTML, head and JSON-LD field differences, challenge or error gates, and a not_checked list.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the page to analyse

name: analyze_page
title: Compare raw HTML with rendered DOM
